data.title: Sysco expands AI push after posting $22.1 billion in Q4 sales

data.title: How Shopify is approaching agentic AI so far in 2026
data.description: Its CEO said early data indicates AI-powered search "has been particularly helpful to some of the smaller brands that form the long tail of commerce."

data.title: Ecommerce Trends: What online shoppers said will matter in 2026 holiday survey results
data.description: Nearly half of shoppers ages 18-29 expect to spend more this holiday season, and 40% of consumers are already using AI to support shopping decisions.

data.title: Ahold Delhaize USA adds Pear Commerce to connect CPG content to online grocery carts

data.title: ShipBob adds Claude-integrated AI to in-house fulfillment tech suite
